second_financing_evidence_note: VERIFIED: Ameluz PDT sBCC Phase 3 topline was announced 2024-10-31. Biofrontera closed a $4.2M senior secured convertible-note financing on 2024-11-22. A separate Series C preferred-stock financing totaling $11M was subsequently funded in 2025, with the final $2.5M tranche confirmed at the 2025-10-23 strategic-transaction closing. This establishes a second separate post-Phase-3 financing.

VERIFIED: SAPPHIRE Phase 3 topline was 2024-10-07. Scholar Rock confirms its upsized public offering closed on 2024-10-10. A later separate debt-financing tranche of $50.0M was received on 2025-09-29, establishing a second post-Phase-3 financing/funding event.

VERIFIED: VEGA-3 Phase 3 topline was 2025-06-26. Opus confirms the November 2025 registered direct offering closed on 2025-11-10. Its February 2026 private placement then closed on 2026-02-18 for approximately $25.0M gross proceeds, establishing a second separate post-Phase-3 financing close.

RESEARCHED: VEGA-3 Phase 3 belongs to Opus' phentolamine program; Viatris holds U.S. commercialization/regulatory rights. Opus financing cannot be transferred to Viatris, and two qualifying Viatris post-readout financing closes were not verified for this exact program.

RESEARCHED: B-Well Phase 3 topline was reported in January 2026. Ionis' $770M convertible-note offering closed in November 2025, before the relevant readout, so it does not count. Two later qualifying post-readout closes were not verified.
RESEARCHED: the submitted INO-3107 evidence is Phase 1/2, not a completed qualifying Phase 3 program. Financing exists, but the strict post-Phase-3 second-financing rule is not applicable.

RESEARCHED: RISE UP Phase 3 topline was reported in November 2025. SEC/issuer review did not verify two separate post-readout financing closes; Agios remained well capitalized with roughly $1B cash/marketable securities during 2026.

VERIFIED: MAPLE-HCM Phase 3 primary results were announced 2025-08-30. Cytokinetics issued $750.0M of 1.75% convertible senior notes on 2025-09-19. A later separate common-stock public offering, including full exercise of the option, generated approximately $760.2M net proceeds and was reported on 2026-05-08. This establishes a second separate post-Phase-3 financing.

VERIFIED: Global HARMONi Phase 3 topline was announced 2025-05-30. SEC filings show actual ATM share sales after the readout produced $74.796M net proceeds by 2025-09-30. A separate October 2025 PIPE for approximately $500.0M gross proceeds was completed in October 2025. Actual funded ATM sales are counted as financing #1 because shares were sold and cash was received; the completed PIPE is financing #2.

RESEARCHED: HOPE-3 topline was announced 2025-12-03 and the December 2025 underwritten offering is a clean post-readout financing. The $77.5M ATM sales were accumulated between 2025-09-10 and year-end, and public filings do not isolate enough of those sales to after the Phase 3 readout, so they are not counted as a separate post-readout financing.

VERIFIED: FORTIFY Phase 3 positive topline was announced 2025-10-27. BridgeBio issued $632.5M principal amount of convertible notes on 2026-01-21 and received approximately $619.3M net proceeds. On 2026-07-01, purchasers bought $933.9M of Series A preferred stock on the stated Closing Date. This is a second separate post-Phase-3 financing.

RESEARCHED: RAINIER Phase 3 interim data support the U.S. BLA. SEC/issuer review did not verify two separate Vertex capital-raising closes after that readout that meet the small/mid-biotech post-readout financing rule.
RESEARCHED: Vertex is the U.S. BLA sponsor; Zai Lab participates in Greater China. Vertex financing cannot be transferred to Zai, and the U.S. application is not a separate Zai financing case.

RESEARCHED: imsidolimab was licensed to Vanda and the current BLA is Vanda's regulatory application. AnaptysBio financing is not being attributed to the applicant without program/company-specific evidence.
RESEARCHED: the relacorilant program has qualifying Phase 3 evidence, but SEC/issuer review did not verify two separate post-readout capital-raising closes meeting the strict rule.

VERIFIED: Phase 3 Launch-HTN topline 2025-03-10. First post-readout public offering commenced 2025-03-10 and was priced 2025-03-11; a later September 2025 underwritten public offering generated about $269.6M net proceeds. Second qualifying post-Phase-3 financing completed.
RESEARCHED: the application is supported by the pivotal iMMagine-1 Phase 2 study, not a completed Phase 3 trial. Strict post-Phase-3 second-financing status is therefore not applicable.
RESEARCHED: the relutrigine NDA is based on the Phase 2 EMBOLD study. Praxis financing verified for the separate ulixacaltamide Phase 3 event is not transferred to this event.
RESEARCHED: MR-107A-02 has Phase 3 acute-pain evidence and an accepted NDA, but review did not verify two separate post-readout Viatris financing closes that meet the strict program-window rule.

VERIFIED: SUMMIT Phase 3 topline was 2025-07-07. Cogent confirms the July 2025 public offering completed on 2025-07-10 with approximately $215.8M net proceeds. A later separate convertible-notes public offering completed on 2025-11-18 for $230M principal including the exercised over-allotment option.

RESEARCHED: the pivotal TRUST-I/TRUST-II studies supporting advanced ROS1+ NSCLC are Phase 2; ongoing TRUST-III/IV are Phase 3 but are not the completed pivotal evidence for the current application. Strict post-Phase-3 financing rule not applied.

VERIFIED: The papillary ANKTIVA application is supported by Cohort B of QUILT-3.032, a registrational Phase 2/3 trial that reported its papillary primary endpoint met on 2021-10-19. ImmunityBio's 2025 Form 10-Q confirms the April 2025 registered direct transaction generated approximately $74.8M net proceeds and the July 28, 2025 registered direct transaction generated approximately $75.4M net proceeds. These are two separate funded post-readout financings.

RESEARCHED: the BLA was submitted for accelerated approval before the global confirmatory Phase 3 trial was completed; Dyne planned/initiated Phase 3 after the BLA path. The strict completed-Phase-3 financing rule is not met.

VERIFIED: Essential3 Phase 3 topline 2025-10-16. First post-readout offering entered 2025-10-16 and completed 2025-10-20. Second post-readout public offering was announced/priced 2026-01-06 and completed 2026-01-07 with about $621.2M net proceeds.
RESEARCHED: the infant atopic-dermatitis application is supported by the Phase 2 INTEGUMENT-INFANT study, not a completed Phase 3 trial.
RESEARCHED: REZILIENT3 Phase 3 results were reported in September 2026. SEC/issuer website review through 2026-10-04 did not verify two separate post-readout financing closes.

VERIFIED: Oxnimbi Phase 3 SynAIRgy/LunAIRo trials were completed before the 2026 financing sequence. Apnimed states it completed two financing transactions supporting launch readiness: an upsized IPO ($220.8M gross) and a senior secured credit facility up to $150M. Second qualifying financing completed.

RESEARCHED: current filing is an sNDA for full approval of VOXZOGO. BioMarin completed large corporate debt financing in 2026, but two separate post-readout financings tied to the relevant PDUFA/Phase-3 window were not verified under the strict rule.
RESEARCHED: STELLAR-303 is a qualifying Phase 3 program; SEC/issuer review did not verify two separate post-readout capital-raising closes meeting the strict rule.

VERIFIED: HAELO Phase 3 positive results were announced 2026-04-27. Intellia's follow-on public offering closed on 2026-04-30 for approximately $194.6M net proceeds. A later separate OrbiMed senior secured credit facility closed on 2026-09-04 with $75M drawn on the Closing Date, establishing the second post-Phase-3 financing close.
RESEARCHED: Pitolisant GR NDA is supported by a pivotal bioequivalence study rather than a Phase 3 efficacy trial. Strict post-Phase-3 financing rule is not applicable.

RESEARCHED: RINGSIDE Phase 3 topline was reported 2025-12-15 and Immunome's December 2025 follow-on public offering was completed. A second separate post-readout financing close was not verified in the website/SEC review.

VERIFIED: ENCORE Phase 3 results for AXS-12 were announced 2024-11-26. On 2025-05-08 Axsome closed the Blackstone financing package, including a $120M funded term loan and concurrent $15M private placement; this is treated as one financing package. In 2026 Axsome separately sold shares through its ATM and received approximately $19.5M net proceeds during the six months ended 2026-06-30. Actual funded ATM sales are counted as a separate second post-Phase-3 financing because shares were sold and cash was received.

VERIFIED: CALIBRATE Phase 3 positive topline for encaleret was announced 2025-10-29. BridgeBio issued $632.5M principal amount of convertible notes on 2026-01-21 and received approximately $619.3M net proceeds. On 2026-07-01, purchasers bought $933.9M of Series A preferred stock on the stated Closing Date. This is a second separate post-Phase-3 financing.

RESEARCHED: SUCCESSOR-2 produced positive Phase 3 results in 2026 and supports the NDA. SEC review did not verify two separate post-readout BMS capital raises that meet the biotech financing-sequence rule.

VERIFIED: INDIGO Phase 3 positive results were announced 2026-01-05. Zenas drew $75M under its Pharmakon term loan on 2026-03-27 (about $73M net). A separate public convertible-notes offering completed 2026-03-31 for $200M principal, establishing a second post-Phase-3 financing close.

VERIFIED: IMPALA-2 Phase 3 positive topline was announced 2024-06-26. Savara entered the Hercules debt financing on 2025-03-26 with $30M funded at close. A later underwritten public offering closed 2025-10-31 and produced approximately $140.2M net proceeds, establishing a second separate post-Phase-3 financing.

VERIFIED: PEAK Phase 3 positive results were announced 2025-11-10. Cogent completed the $230.0M convertible-notes offering on 2025-11-18 as part of its post-readout capital raise. During Q1 2026, the company then sold shares under its ATM program for $45.7M net proceeds, confirming a later separate funded financing by 2026-03-31.
